verdict.rationale: Migration credits are a fair pricing question for a cloud hosting platform like Fly.io, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only pay-as-you-go pricing and a claim that customers avoid platform migration as they scale. Neither is a credit or incentive program for teams moving production infrastructure onto Fly.io.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can receive migration credits when moving my production infrastructure to a new platform
